title: Shelf
summary: One set of octane/data contracts and one server: server-rendered Octane and React pages that hydrate from the server's data, and an Octane page hosting a React island that shares its store.

journeys.title: Arrive server-rendered, readable without JavaScript, and hydrate from the server's data without loading it again
Show an edit before its reply, then settle it with the affected reads returned in the same response
Add and remove books by ID, and roll back a refused add
Settle a write whose reply was lost by looking up its receipt, without resending it
Keep an offline edit until a lookup shows it never arrived, then roll it back
Give each account its own store and keep the other account's data out
Show one edit and one rollback in an Octane page and its React island
Start the lists from the encrypted cache after a reload, without loading them, and keep titles unreadable at rest

faultScenarios.description: Lose the next reply delivers a write and discards its reply, so the edit stays visible as uncertain until a receipt lookup confirms it.
Offline fails requests before they are sent; a later lookup shows the write never arrived and removes its edit.
Adding a title already on the shelf is refused by the server and the optimistic row is removed.
